"The only constant is change", it's said, and often is true.  Due to recent leadership changes at Fred Hutch, the capabilities this site referenced are being structured differently with new web homes.  Please update your bookmarks and find what's next at these various sites.  

## Translational Data at Fred Hutch

For all Translational data capabilities built by DaSL/OCDO, please see the [Translational Data Accelerator's public homepage](https://accelerator.fredhutch.org).  

## SciWiki
We remain committed to building a shared knowledgebase around data science in biomedical research via the [Biomedical Data Science Wiki effort](https://sciwiki.fredhutch.org/).  

## Data Science Training at Fred Hutch
For the time being, our Fred Hutch based training resources will remain [on our training page in this site](https://ocdo.fredhutch.org/dasl/). A future home is being determined. 

## Cancer AI Alliance
The Cancer AI Alliance initiative continues and the best resource for that work remains at [the CAIA site](https://www.canceralliance.ai/).

## Data Science Affiliates
Our Data Science oriented training affiliates remain over on the [hutchdatascience.org](https://hutchdatascience.org/) site.  



All good efforts have their time and the entire Data Science Lab team want to thank everyone who contributed, collaborated and supported our work over the years and helped us make a positive impact on biomedical data science here at the Fred Hutch and beyond.  We look forward to many more innovative efforts that build on what we've done together now and into the future!
